sequence A and sequence B, encoder
The two lines that create four heads without copying anything

Reshapes are the easiest part of a Transformer to skim past and the easiest to get wrong. Seeing the same numbers appear in three arrangements — flat, grouped, and grouped with the axes swapped — is the quickest way to believe that multi-head attention adds no parameters and no arithmetic of its own.

B · Shapes and strides, stage by stage
the stride is what proves nothing was copied
The same numbers, seven different ways of reading them
A tensor is a flat block of memory plus a rule for reading it. That rule is the stride: how many numbers to skip to move one step along each axis.
only ever rewrite the rule — which is why the numbers on this page never change, and why
